summary.verdict_desc: 本周计数 7 红 / 7 黄 / 11 绿，红灯比例由 24.0% 升至 28.0%、加权风险分由 38.0% 升至 42.0%——沉寂多周的头条读数首次实质性向上，而且两处恶化都落在快变量（trigger）一侧，这正是本体系最看重的『引线』信号。两处边际恶化：其一，资本开支市场反应由黄转红。Alphabet 于 7/22 盘后公布 Q2，云收入暴涨 82%（$247.7 亿）、积压升至 $514B（环比 +$50B）、各项全面超预期，市场却只盯住其把 2026 全年 capex 指引上调至 $195-205B 并预告 2027『显著增加』，7/23 股价重挫约 7.4%（Tesla+Alphabet 单日蒸发数千亿市值，纳指 -2.15%）。关键在于：Alphabet 恰是此前『有云变现→被奖励』阵营的标杆，如今连它都因加码 capex 被重罚，说明市场的反应函数已切换为『无差别惩罚资本开支』——由『选择性惩罚』（黄）升级为『系统性惩罚』（红）。需并记：Q2 财报季刚开场，MSFT/Meta 7/29、Amazon 7/30 才出，本判定将于下期用其余三家反应交叉确认。其二，AI 收入二阶导由绿转黄。据 TickerTrends/KuCoin 追踪，Anthropic ARR 年化跑量 7 月约 $74.1B（6 月约 $69.6B、4 月约 $35.6B），单月增量由此前约 +$17B/月骤降至约 +$4.5B/月——增速本身开始回落，二阶导转负，追踪方明确以『growth beginning to decelerate』定性；OpenAI 仍升至约 $41.3B（5 月约 $33B）尚在加速。绝对收入仍强劲增长，但作为快变量的领跑者 Anthropic 增速首次转弱，判为『平稳/见顶迹象』（黄）——这是基本面侧首次出现 trigger 裂缝。两处恶化、零好转，动量净 +2（1 级恶化各计 1），为连续数周净 0 后首次净恶化，但未及 +4 的『边际恶化加速』阈值。两轴判读：泡沫成熟度 stage 维持 60.0（亢奋 Euphoria——估值、VC 集中度、vendor financing 依旧泡沫化），破裂临近度 trigger 由 23.3 升至 30.0，首次跨过 25 分界、由『引线未燃 Fuse Unlit』进入『零星火花 Sparks』——引线开始冒火星（capex 惩罚 + ARR 减速两处触发）。一句话：『泡沫仍大且未见收缩，但引线本周首次冒出火星——顶部确认清单又划掉两项分歧。』估值端极端未改：CAPE 约 40.6（multpl 40.46 @7/24、GuruFocus 40.86 @7/1），较上周约 41.3 微降但仍逼近 2000 峰值 44.2；S&P 前 5 大权重约 26.5%（slickcharts 实时源仍 egress 受限，二手读 NVDA 7.0/AAPL 6.3/MSFT 4.6、前 10 大约 37%，AI 硬件回调略削集中度但仍压 25% 红线上方）；唯 NVDA 远期 PE 约 21.5x（GuruFocus 22.72、StockAnalysis 20.76）维持绿灯——EPS 上修使龙头倍数随股价走低。资金面仍是最大压力源（类别分 87.5、3 红）：Alphabet Q2 自由现金流转负至 -$58.55 亿（其公开上市史上首次为负），坐实 Mag4 FCF 深度红灯；AI 占全球 VC 约 70%（美国 H1 86%、OpenAI+Anthropic 两家 $217B）；NVDA 客户投资/收入约 43%（$40B+ 承诺 / $300B LTM，承诺额环比未再扩张、循环融资口实仍在）。信用面继续最强支撑（类别分 12.5）：HY 利差约 277bps（govspending 7/23 报 2.77%，较上周约 269 微升但仍远低于 350 阈值）、数据中心 ABS 条件维持宽松（KBRA 7/15 研讨会点名电力/租户集中/再融资为风险但无利差走阔）、Neocloud 90 日零信用事件（Nebius 因 NVDA 披露 9.3% 持股单日 +16%、CoreWeave +8%，属股权且偏正面）。市场结构类别分维持 66.7（内部人续红）：本周无新增聚合美元比，沿用上期约 25x 方向性估算（LevelFields $688M 五家龙头卖出集群、买盘归零），仍为红灯。基本面首现裂缝（类别分由 0.0 升至 8.3，因 ARR 转黄）：OpenRouter 约 100T/月绝对量与上期持平、+35% 环比已连续 5 期沿用，本期继续标记 token_volume_mom 疑似静态待人工核查；GPU 现货 H100 SXM5 约 $3.94/hr（现货 $2.91）、H200 中位约 $4.11、约半数售罄无过剩，维持紧俏绿灯；Oracle RPO $638B 叠加 MSFT $627B、Google 积压升至 $514B，大三积压 >$1.7T，云订单强劲绿灯；前沿进展在轨（METR Mythos 级 50% 时程约 16 小时、倍增约 7 月，Claude Fable 5 续居 HLE 53.3%/SWE-bench Pro 80.3% SOTA）。宏观情绪：Fed 维持黄灯但内部恶化——CME FedWatch（7/23）显示 7/29 约 63.5% 维持、加息概率回升至约三分之一（通胀粘性→higher-for-longer），政策仍属『维持高利率(通胀压力)』而非加息，未改判；capex 反应转红（见上）；CEO 对冲维持黄灯（Pichai 于 Q2 电话会警示『AI 泡沫破裂无人能免，包括我们』，但各家仍集体加码 capex 未收手）。判读：基础档位按 red_pct 28.0%（25-40）本为『中度警戒』，估值 2 红（CAPE、Top-5）叠加资金面 3 红（FCF、VC AI 占比、NVDA 客户投资），估值 + 资金面双类共振触发分类强制升级，维持『高风险预警』。两轴升级条件（stage≥60 且 trigger≥50）因 trigger 仅 30.0 仍未触发——但 trigger 本周由 23.3 抬至 30.0，是通往两轴升级的第一步，值得高度警惕。历史相似度出现转折：当前格局本周最像 2000-02（顶前 1 个月，74%），首次反超 1999-06（顶前 9 个月，72%）——驱动来自 capex 反应转红（趋同于晚周期市场审视）与 ARR 减速；2021-11（成长股/SPAC 顶，70%）居三，2007-10（41%）最不像。与 2000-02（顶前 1 个月）向量的主要差异（即接下来确认进入顶部前夜要盯的信号）：NVDA 远期 PE 仍便宜（21.5x vs 泡沫化）、信用面三绿未破（HY 277bps / ABS 收窄 / Neocloud 零事件，均 vs 2000 的走阔）、债务/capex 仍中性（55% vs 顶部 80-100%）、IPO 未成洪流（Anthropic 已入 roadshow 瞄准 10 月但临近名单仍 <10）、Fed 维持而非明确加息（63.5% 维持 vs 2000 明确加息）；值得注意的是 capex 反应本周已『红过』2000-02（当时为黄），是当前向量少数比顶前 1 个月更极端之处。分母提醒：N=25 下 7 红对应 28.0%，跨期趋势以方向为主。（动量净 +2，未及 +4 提示阈值，但为多周来首次净恶化。）
summary.verdict_desc_en: This week prints 7 red / 7 yellow / 11 green, with the red share rising from 24.0% to 28.0% and the weighted risk score from 38.0% to 42.0% — the first real upward move in the headline reads after weeks of stasis, and, tellingly, both deteriorations land on the fast-variable (trigger) side, precisely the 'fuse' signals this framework weights most. Two marginal deteriorations. First, the capex-guidance reaction turned from yellow to red. Alphabet reported Q2 after the July 22 close with cloud revenue up 82% ($24.77B), backlog rising to $514B (+$50B sequentially) and beats across the board — yet the market fixated solely on its raising full-year 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B and flagging a 'significant increase' in 2027, and the stock fell ~7.4% on July 23 (Tesla and Alphabet erased hundreds of billions in a session; the Nasdaq fell 2.15%). The key point: Alphabet was the poster child of the 'monetizes via cloud → gets rewarded' camp, and if even it is punished hard for leaning into capex, the market's reaction function has switched to punishing capital spending indiscriminately — an upgrade from 'selective punishment' (yellow) to 'systematic punishment' (red). One caveat to log: Q2 earnings season has only just begun, with MSFT/Meta on July 29 and Amazon on July 30, so this call will be cross-confirmed next period against the other three reactions. Second, the AI revenue second derivative turned from green to yellow. Per TickerTrends/KuCoin tracking, Anthropic's annualized ARR run-rate was ~$74.1B in July (~$69.6B in June, ~$35.6B in April), so the monthly increment collapsed from ~+$17B/month to ~+$4.5B/month — the growth rate itself is rolling over, the second derivative has turned negative, and the tracker explicitly characterizes it as 'growth beginning to decelerate'; OpenAI still rose to ~$41.3B (from ~$33B in May) and remains in acceleration. Absolute revenue is still growing strongly, but the fast-variable leader Anthropic has weakened for the first time, so the read moves to 'flattening / topping signs' (yellow) — the first trigger crack on the fundamentals side. Two deteriorations, zero improvements, net momentum +2 (each one-notch move counts 1) — the first net deterioration after several net-0 weeks, though still below the +4 'accelerating deterioration' threshold. Two-axis read: bubble maturity 'stage' holds at 60.0 (Euphoria — valuations, VC concentration and vendor financing remain bubble-grade), while rupture proximity 'trigger' rose from 23.3 to 30.0, crossing the 25 boundary for the first time from 'Fuse Unlit' into 'Sparks' — the fuse is throwing its first sparks (the capex-punishment and ARR-deceleration triggers). In one line: the bubble is still large with no sign of shrinking, but the fuse threw its first sparks this week — the top-confirmation checklist crossed off two more divergences. Valuations stay extreme: CAPE ~40.6 (multpl 40.46 on July 24, GuruFocus 40.86 on July 1), a touch below last week's ~41.3 but still edging toward the 2000 peak of 44.2; the S&P Top-5 weight is ~26.5% (the live Slickcharts source remains egress-blocked; secondary reads put NVDA at 7.0 / AAPL 6.3 / MSFT 4.6 and the Top-10 at ~37%, with the AI-hardware pullback trimming concentration slightly but still above the 25% red line); only NVDA's ~21.5x forward PE (GuruFocus 22.72, StockAnalysis 20.76) stays green as EPS upgrades pull the leader's multiple down. Capital remains the biggest pressure point (category 87.5, three reds): Alphabet's Q2 free cash flow turned negative at -$5.855B (the first negative FCF in its public history), cementing the deep Mag4 FCF red; AI is ~70% of global VC (86% of US H1, OpenAI and Anthropic alone $217B); and NVDA customer-financing runs ~43% of revenue ($40B+ committed against ~$300B LTM, with commitments no longer expanding sequentially but the circular-financing critique intact). Credit remains the strongest support (category 12.5): HY OAS ~277bps (govspending 2.77% on July 23, up slightly from last week's ~269 but far below the 350 threshold), data-center ABS conditions stay accommodative (KBRA's July 15 webinar flagged power/tenant-concentration/refinancing as risks but no spread widening), and neocloud credit logged zero events in 90 days (Nebius rose 16% in a session and CoreWeave 8% on NVDA's disclosure of a 9.3% Nebius stake — an equity move, and a positive one). The market-structure category holds at 66.7 (insiders stay red): no fresh aggregate dollar ratio this week, so last period's directional ~25x is carried (the LevelFields $688M five-leader selling cluster with buying near zero) — still red. Fundamentals show their first crack (category up from 0.0 to 8.3 on the ARR yellow): OpenRouter is flat at ~100T/month versus last period and the +35% MoM has now been carried for five straight weeks, so token_volume_mom stays flagged suspect-static for manual review; GPU spot H100 SXM5 is ~$3.94/hr (spot ~$2.91) and H200 median ~$4.11 with about half of providers sold out and no glut, staying tight and green; Oracle RPO $638B plus Microsoft's $627B and Google's backlog rising to $514B keep big-3 backlog above $1.7T, a strong-and-green order book; and frontier progress stays on-trend (METR Mythos-class 50% horizon ~16 hours, doubling ~every 7 months, with Claude Fable 5 still holding HLE 53.3% / SWE-bench Pro 80.3% SOTA). Macro/sentiment: the Fed stays yellow but deteriorates internally — CME FedWatch (July 23) shows ~63.5% hold at July 29 with hike odds back up to roughly one-third (sticky inflation → higher-for-longer), so policy remains 'higher-for-longer hold (inflation pressure)' rather than a hike and is not re-rated; the capex reaction turns red (above); CEO hedging holds yellow (Pichai on the Q2 call warned 'no company will be immune if the AI bubble bursts, including us', yet all continue to raise capex rather than pull back). Verdict: the base framework reads Moderate Caution on red_pct of 28.0% (25-40), but valuation 2 red (CAPE, Top-5) plus capital 3 red (FCF, VC AI share, NVDA customer-financing) fire the dual-category resonance override, holding the verdict at High Risk Alert. The two-axis upgrade (stage>=60 and trigger>=50) still does not fire because trigger is only 30.0 — but trigger rose from 23.3 to 30.0 this week, the first step toward that upgrade, and warrants close watch. Historical similarity turned a corner: the current configuration this week most resembles February 2000 (one month before the top, 74%), overtaking June 1999 (nine months before the top, 72%) for the first time — driven by the capex reaction turning red (converging on late-cycle market scrutiny) and the ARR deceleration; November 2021 (Growth/SPAC top, 70%) is third and October 2007 (41%) least alike. The main differences versus the February 2000 vector — the signals to watch to confirm entry into the top's eve — are: NVDA's forward PE still cheap (21.5x vs bubble-grade), the three credit greens unbroken (HY 277bps / ABS tightening / neocloud zero events, all vs widening in 2000), debt/capex still moderate (55% vs an 80-100% peak), the IPO pipeline not a flood (Anthropic is in its roadshow targeting October but imminent names are still under 10), and the Fed holding rather than clearly hiking (63.5% hold vs a clear hike in 2000); notably, the capex reaction is now 'redder' than February 2000 (which was yellow), one of the few places the current vector is more extreme than one month before the top. Denominator reminder: with N=25 the seven reds map to 28.0%, so cross-period trend comparison should lean on direction. (Net momentum +2, below the +4 alert threshold, but the first net deterioration in weeks.)

wow_changes.note: 资本开支市场反应转为系统性惩罚——Alphabet 7/22 Q2 云收入 +82%、积压 $514B 全面超预期，却因把 2026 capex 上调至 $195-205B 于 7/23 重挫约 7.4%（纳指 -2.15%）。连『有云变现』标杆都因加码 capex 被重罚，市场反应函数切换为无差别惩罚资本开支，由黄升红（Q2 财报季刚开场，MSFT/Meta 7/29、Amazon 7/30 待确认）
wow_changes.note_en: The capex reaction turned to systematic punishment — Alphabet's July 22 Q2 beat across the board (cloud +82%, backlog $514B), yet the stock fell ~7.4% on July 23 (Nasdaq -2.15%) for raising 2026 capex guidance to $195-205B. If even the 'monetizes via cloud' bellwether is punished for leaning into capex, the market's reaction function has switched to punishing capital spending indiscriminately, yellow to red (Q2 season just started; MSFT/Meta July 29, Amazon July 30 to confirm)

wow_changes.note: AI 收入二阶导由加速转平稳——Anthropic ARR 年化跑量 7 月约 $74.1B（6 月约 $69.6B），单月增量由此前约 +$17B/月骤降至约 +$4.5B/月，增速本身回落、二阶导转负，追踪方以『growth beginning to decelerate』定性；OpenAI 仍升至约 $41.3B 尚在加速。基本面侧首次出现 trigger 裂缝，由绿降黄
wow_changes.note_en: The AI revenue second derivative eased from accelerating to flat — Anthropic's annualized ARR run-rate was ~$74.1B in July (~$69.6B in June), with the monthly increment collapsing from ~+$17B to ~+$4.5B; the growth rate itself is rolling over, the second derivative has turned negative, and the tracker calls it 'growth beginning to decelerate'. OpenAI still rose to ~$41.3B and remains in acceleration. The first trigger crack on the fundamentals side — green to yellow

wow_changes.note: 市场广度走弱——本周获 S5FI 现值读数约 48.5%（7/24），较上期沿用的约 54.1% 下降约 10.4%，逼近 40% 黄/红分界；S&P 500 指数续处自身 50 日均线下方、AI 硬件轮动流出。仍落 40-60% 黄区未破红，但方向明确转弱，维持黄灯
wow_changes.note_en: Market breadth weakened — a fresh S5FI read of ~48.5% (July 24) was obtained this week, down ~10.4% from the carried ~54.1%, nearing the 40% yellow/red divide; the S&P 500 index remains below its own 50-day MA with money rotating out of AI hardware. Still inside the 40-60% yellow band and not yet red, but the direction is decisively weaker — stays yellow

indicators.note: CAPE 约 40.6（multpl 40.46 @7/24、GuruFocus 40.86 @7/1、其它约 41.37），较上周约 41.3 微降（AI 硬件回调所致），仍逼近 2000 年峰值 44.2（仅差约 8%），远高于长期均值约 32、中位数约 16，估值处极度拉伸区，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: CAPE is ~40.6 (multpl 40.46 on July 24, GuruFocus 40.86 on July 1, others ~41.37), a touch below last week's ~41.3 on the AI-hardware pullback and still only ~8% below the 2000 peak of 44.2 — far above its ~32 long-run average and ~16 median; valuations remain extremely stretched, stays red

indicators.note_en: NVDA's forward PE is ~21.5x (GuruFocus 22.72 on July 18, StockAnalysis 20.76; ~20-23x range), a meaningful discount to the ~35 semiconductor median; ongoing EPS upgrades pull the multiple down even as the stock rises — NVDA's valuation is not the bubble's source, stays green

indicators.name_zh: AI 私募二级市场标价
indicators.threshold_text: 折价/下跌=红 / 溢价收窄+卖压=黄 / 溢价稳定或扩大=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Discount/falling = red / Narrowing premium + sell pressure = yellow / Stable-to-wider premium = green
indicators.note: 二级标价持续走强：Anthropic 隐含估值约 $1.2T（Caplight，+550% YoY，对 $965B Series H 溢价约 24%，卖方近乎绝迹、买卖意向比约 5:2 领先 OpenAI），成为『二级市场史上最抢手标的』；OpenAI 约 $933B（Caplight，近 3 月 +20%，GPT-5.6/Codex 重燃买方兴趣、明显回暖但仍慢于 Anthropic）。旗舰均无折价、溢价扩大，一级市场无退潮信号，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: Secondary marks keep firming: Anthropic's implied valuation is ~$1.2T (Caplight, +550% YoY, ~24% above its $965B Series H), with sellers all but absent and a ~5:2 buyer-interest ratio over OpenAI — 'the most sought-after name the secondary market has ever seen'; OpenAI is ~$933B (Caplight, +20% over three months, with GPT-5.6/Codex rekindling buyer interest — a clear resurgence, though still slower than Anthropic). No flagship trades at a discount and premiums are widening — no retreat signal, stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 指引下调=红 / 加速=黄 / 稳健=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Guidance cut = red / Accelerating = yellow / Steady = green
indicators.note: Alphabet 于 Q2（7/22）把 2026 capex 指引由约 $175-185B 上调至 $195-205B 并预告 2027『显著增加』，Q2 单季 capex $44.9B（同比 +101%）；四大 2026 合计约 $745B（AMZN $200B、MSFT $190B、GOOGL 约 $200B、META $125-145B），YoY 约 +80%（对 2025 约 $410B），无一下调、均重申或上调。绝对增速仍在加速、不可持续特征明显，维持黄灯（MSFT/Meta 7/29、Amazon 7/30 待更新）
indicators.note_en: Alphabet at Q2 (July 22) raised 2026 capex guidance from ~$175-185B to $195-205B and flagged a 'significant increase' in 2027, with Q2 capex of $44.9B (+101% YoY); the four hyperscalers now guide ~$745B for 2026 (AMZN $200B, MSFT $190B, GOOGL ~$200B, META $125-145B), ~+80% YoY (vs ~$410B in 2025), with none cutting and all reaffirming or raising. The pace is still accelerating with clear unsustainability hallmarks — stays yellow (MSFT/Meta July 29, Amazon July 30 to update)

indicators.threshold_text_en: <-20% red / -20%~0 yellow / >0 green
indicators.note: 自由现金流被 capex 深度吞噬，本周首现硬数据坐实：Alphabet Q2 FCF 转负至 -$58.55 亿（其公开上市史上首次为负，$44.9B capex 吞掉经营现金流），全年 FCF 料同比骤降约 90%；Amazon 2026 全年 FCF 亦料转负（$200B capex vs 约 $139.5B 经营现金流）。Mag7 由造现金转向吞现金、需外部融资，维持红灯（MSFT/Meta/Amazon Q2 7/29-30 待更新）
indicators.note_en: Free cash flow is being deeply consumed by capex, now confirmed with hard data: Alphabet's Q2 FCF turned negative at -$5.855B (the first negative FCF in its public history, as $44.9B of capex swallowed operating cash flow), with full-year FCF set to fall ~90% YoY; Amazon's 2026 FCF is also set to turn negative ($200B capex vs ~$139.5B operating cash flow). The Mag7 have shifted from generating cash to consuming it, leaning on external financing — stays red (MSFT/Meta/Amazon Q2 July 29-30 to update)

indicators.name_zh: AI 占 VC 投资比重
indicators.threshold_text_en: >50% red / 30-50% yellow / <30% green
indicators.note: 沿用 PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026 硬数据（H1 报告为最新，本周无新季度披露）：AI 占全球创投超 70%（一年前不足 50%）、占美国创投达 86%（$355.9B）；H1 全球创投创纪录 $510B、OpenAI+Anthropic 两家占 43%（$217B）。美元高度集中于少数巨额轮次，远超 50% 红线，维持红灯
indicators.note_en: PitchBook/Crunchbase H1 2026 hard data is carried (H1 reports are the freshest; no new quarterly print this week): AI took >70% of global VC (up from under 50% a year ago) and 86% of US VC ($355.9B); record H1 global VC of $510B, with OpenAI and Anthropic alone at 43% ($217B). Dollars concentrate in a few mega-rounds far above the 50% red line — stays red

indicators.threshold_text_en: >30% red / 15-30% yellow / <15% green (Lucent '99 peak: 24%)
indicators.note: NVDA 2026 年 AI 股权承诺逾 $40B（OpenAI $30B 直投 + Corning、IREN、CoreWeave/Marvell/Lumentum/Coherent 等），占约 $300B LTM 收入约 43%，远超 Lucent 1999 峰值 24%；连续红灯，承诺额环比未再扩张（本期无新增大额承诺），但『为自身供应链融资+锁客』的循环特征持续受质疑（CoreWeave $6.3B 产能采购协议为最典型案例），维持红灯
indicators.note_en: NVDA committed $40B+ of AI equity in 2026 ($30B direct into OpenAI plus Corning, IREN, and CoreWeave / Marvell / Lumentum / Coherent), ~43% of ~$300B LTM revenue — far above Lucent's 1999 peak of 24%; a persistent red, with commitments no longer expanding sequentially (no new large commitment this period) but the 'financing its own supply chain while locking in customers' loop still under scrutiny (CoreWeave's $6.3B capacity-purchase agreement is the archetype) — stays red

indicators.threshold_text_en: <40% red / 40-60% yellow / >60% green
indicators.note: 本周获 S5FI 现值读数约 48.5%（7/24 收盘），较上期沿用的约 54.1% 明显走弱（-10.4%），落在 40-60% 黄区但逼近 40% 分界；S&P 500 指数续处自身 50 日均线下方、AI 硬件/存储轮动流出、SOX 承压。多数个股已跌破短期趋势，头部独撑特征加深，维持黄灯（较上周新增实测硬数据、撤下沿用标记）
indicators.note_en: A current S5FI read of ~48.5% was obtained this week (July 24 close), a marked weakening from the carried ~54.1% (-10.4%), inside the 40-60% yellow band but nearing the 40% divide; the S&P 500 index remains below its own 50-day MA, money is rotating out of AI hardware/memory, and the SOX is under pressure. Most stocks have slipped below their short-term trend, deepening the narrow-leadership tape — stays yellow (a fresh measured read this week replaces the carried value)

indicators.name_zh: AI 龙头内部人卖买比
indicators.threshold_text_en: >20x = red / 5-20x = yellow / <5x = green (2000 peak: 23x)
indicators.note: 内部人卖压维持决定性红灯：本周无新增 12 家 30 日聚合美元比，沿用上期约 25x 方向性估算——LevelFields 记录五家科技龙头卖出集群约 $688M（Broadcom Samueli 三月累计逾 $651M+ 新报 $71M、NVDA Stevens、Oracle Henley $63.7M、Palantir Karp/Sankar），买盘几近归零（NVDA 一年零买入，AI 板块三年净卖约 $15.6B）。买盘归零使比值远超 20x；聚合美元比仍无法精确获取，25x 为方向性估算（连续第 2 期，未及 3 期同值不触发疑似静态）
indicators.note_en: Insider selling stays a decisive red: no fresh 12-name 30-day aggregate dollar ratio this week, so last period's directional ~25x is carried — LevelFields logged a ~$688M selling cluster across five tech leaders (Broadcom's Samueli $651M+ over three months plus a new $71M filing, NVDA's Stevens, Oracle's Henley $63.7M, Palantir's Karp/Sankar), with buying all but gone (NVDA zero purchases in a year, ~$15.6B of AI-complex net selling over three years). Near-zero buying keeps the ratio well above 20x; the aggregate dollar ratio remains unobtainable, so 25x is a directional estimate (second period at this value, below the three-period threshold for a suspect-static flag)

indicators.threshold_text: 洪流=红 / 升温=黄 / 平静=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Flood = red / Warming = yellow / Quiet = green
indicators.note: 管道继续升温但未成洪流：Anthropic 承销商本周续排投资者会议、瞄准 10 月 Nasdaq 上市（$965B post、约 $69B ARR）；SpaceX 已于 6/12 挂牌（$1.77T、募约 $75B）。OpenAI（confidential S-1 已交）指向 2027、Databricks CEO 称 2026『上市糟糕年』亦推 2027。临近发行（6 个月内）名单实质仍只 Anthropic、总数 <10，窗口谨慎，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: The pipeline keeps warming but is short of a flood: Anthropic's underwriters continued scheduling investor meetings this week, targeting an October Nasdaq listing ($965B post, ~$69B ARR); SpaceX already listed on June 12 ($1.77T, ~$75B raised). OpenAI (confidential S-1 filed) points to 2027, and Databricks' CEO called 2026 a 'terrible year to go public', also pointing to 2027. Imminent (within-6-month) names are still essentially just Anthropic, under 10 total, so the window stays cautious — stays yellow

indicators.threshold_text_en: >500 red / 350-500 yellow / <350 green
indicators.note: ICE BofA HY OAS 约 277bps（govspending 7/23 报 2.77%、TradingEconomics 同值；FRED 主源 egress 受限取镜像），较上周约 269 微升 8bps，仍远低于长期均值约 394bps、中位数约 452bps；尽管 AI capex 持续烧钱、债市对 AI 债券需求边际转挑剔，信用利差层面对 AI 风险仍无压力，是当前最支撑多头的指标，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: ICE BofA HY OAS is ~277bps (govspending 2.77% on July 23, TradingEconomics the same; the primary FRED host was egress-blocked, so a mirror is used), up ~8bps from last week's ~269 and still far below the ~394bps long-run average and ~452bps median; despite ongoing AI capex burn and investors turning marginally pickier on AI bonds, spreads show no stress on AI risk — the most bull-supportive indicator right now, stays green

indicators.name_zh: 数据中心 ABS 利差
indicators.threshold_text: 走阔 50bps+ = 红 / 稳定 = 黄 / 收窄 = 绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widening 50bps+ = red / Stable = yellow / Tightening = green
indicators.note: 数据中心 ABS 条件维持宽松：本周无新利差走阔信号，延续上期顶级券收窄趋势，发行创纪录/近纪录；KBRA 于 7/15 研讨会（7/21 纪要）点名电力接入、执行、租约耐久、租户集中与再融资为增量风险，Barclays 预计 2028 年底存量证券化或达 $180B。风险清单在拉长但利差未反映压力，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: Data-center ABS conditions stay accommodative: no new spread-widening signal this week, extending last period's top-rated tightening trend amid record/near-record issuance; KBRA's July 15 webinar (July 21 recap) flagged power access, execution, lease durability, tenant concentration and refinancing as growing risks, and Barclays sees outstanding securitizations reaching ~$180B by year-end 2028. The risk list is lengthening but spreads do not yet reflect stress — stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 任何违约/降级=红
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any default/downgrade = red
indicators.note: CoreWeave / Nebius / Crusoe / Lambda / IREN 90 日内无评级下调或违约。本周信用侧偏正面——NVIDIA 披露持有 Nebius 约 9.3% 股权，Nebius 单日 +16%、CoreWeave 同情性 +8%；股价虽仍高波动（Meta 自建云担忧、Nebius 曾单日 -13%），均属股权层面。GPU 抵押债与 2026-27 再融资墙仍是潜在隐患，短期零信用事件，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: CoreWeave / Nebius / Crusoe / Lambda / IREN — no downgrades or defaults in 90 days. The credit side skewed positive this week: NVIDIA disclosed a ~9.3% equity stake in Nebius, sending Nebius up 16% in a session and CoreWeave up 8% in sympathy; equities stay volatile (Meta-compute fears, a prior -13% Nebius session) but those are equity moves. GPU-collateralized debt and a 2026-27 refinancing wall remain latent risks — yet with zero near-term credit events it stays green

indicators.name_zh: 全口径债务/Capex 流量比
indicators.threshold_text_en: ≥70% red / 50-70% yellow / <50% green (dot-com peak: 80-100%)
indicators.note: 周度台账：本周无新增单笔 deal（上期 Nebius $0.78B、General Compute $0.40B 已计）；本周边际主题为债市需求转弱——Forbes/Motley Fool 记 AI 债供给逼近 $570B（MS 口径 YTD 5 月底约 $236B，约上年同期 4x），hyperscaler 债券认购倍数下降、投资者要求更高收益，融资更多转向不透明的私募信用/表外结构（约 $800B）。台账仍沿 MS 锚定 2026E 全口径新增债务约 $570B ÷ 全口径 capex 约 $1.04T ≈ 55%（区间 50-60%），低于互联网/电信基建顶 80-100%，维持黄灯。距上次完整对账（7/6）20 天，下次约 8/3
indicators.note_en: Weekly ledger: no new single deal this week (last period's Nebius $0.78B and General Compute $0.40B are already logged); the marginal theme this week is softening bond demand — Forbes/Motley Fool note AI debt approaching $570B (MS basis ~$236B YTD through May, ~4x a year prior), with hyperscaler-bond coverage ratios declining, investors demanding higher yields, and financing shifting toward less-transparent private credit / off-balance-sheet structures (~$800B). The ledger holds MS's anchor of ~$570B of 2026E all-in new AI debt over ~$1.04T all-in capex ≈ 55% (50-60% range), below the 80-100% dot-com/telecom peak — stays yellow. 20 days since the last full reconciliation (July 6); next recon ~Aug 3
indicators.source_name: Morgan Stanley + 自下而上台账

indicators.name_zh: AI 行业 Token 月度环比
indicators.threshold_text: 收缩=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Contraction = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: OpenRouter 约 100T/月、约 1.5 quadrillion/年 run-rate、8M 用户、日请求 >1000 万——但本期仍未获独立新月度环比披露、绝对量与上期持平于约 100T/月，核心 value（+35%）已连续 5 期沿用，本期继续标记 token_volume_mom 疑似静态、待人工核查。行业绝对用量仍处高位扩张、无收缩迹象，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: OpenRouter is ~100T/month, a ~1.5 quadrillion/year run-rate with 8M users and >10M daily requests — but again no independent new monthly print was obtained this period and absolute volume is flat at ~100T/month, so the core value (+35%) has now been carried for five straight weeks and token_volume_mom stays flagged suspect-static for manual review. Industry usage remains at a high, expanding level with no sign of contraction — stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 环比跌>15%/供过于求=红 / 阴跌=黄 / 稳定或上涨=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: -15%+ MoM / glut = red / Drifting lower = yellow / Stable-to-rising = green
indicators.note: H100 SXM5 现货约 $3.94/hr on-demand（spot 约 $2.91）、PCIe 约 $2.01，区间 $2.01-12.29；H200 中位约 $4.11/hr（区间 $2.30-13.78）。可得性约 48-53% 在库（约半数售罄/满载），无供给过剩。本指标为算力供需最直接温度计，价格企稳偏紧、维持绿灯（Blackwell 放量后关注是否转阴跌）
indicators.note_en: H100 SXM5 spot is ~$3.94/hr on-demand (~$2.91 spot) and PCIe ~$2.01, range $2.01-12.29; H200 median ~$4.11/hr (range $2.30-13.78). Availability is ~48-53% in stock (about half sold out / at capacity) with no glut. As the most direct thermometer of compute supply-demand, prices are firm and tight — stays green (watch for a drift lower once Blackwell ramps)

indicators.name_zh: AI 收入增速的二阶导
indicators.threshold_text: 减速=红 / 平稳=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Decel = red / Flat = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: 二阶导本周由绿转黄：据 TickerTrends/KuCoin 追踪，Anthropic ARR 年化跑量 7 月约 $74.1B（6 月约 $69.6B、4 月约 $35.6B、1 月约 $10.2B），单月增量由此前约 +$17B/月骤降至约 +$4.5B/月，增速本身回落、二阶导转负，追踪方明确以『growth beginning to decelerate』定性；OpenAI 仍升至约 $41.3B（5 月约 $33B）尚在加速。绝对收入仍强劲增长，但快变量领跑者 Anthropic 增速首次转弱，判为『平稳/见顶迹象』黄灯（单月口径存 lumpiness，待下期确认是趋势还是噪声）
indicators.note_en: The second derivative turned from green to yellow this week: per TickerTrends/KuCoin tracking, Anthropic's annualized ARR run-rate was ~$74.1B in July (~$69.6B June, ~$35.6B April, ~$10.2B January), so the monthly increment collapsed from ~+$17B to ~+$4.5B — the growth rate itself is rolling over, the second derivative has turned negative, and the tracker calls it 'growth beginning to decelerate'; OpenAI still rose to ~$41.3B (from ~$33B in May) and remains in acceleration. Absolute revenue is still growing strongly, but the fast-variable leader Anthropic has weakened for the first time, so the read is 'flattening / topping signs' (yellow) — a single monthly figure carries lumpiness, so next period will confirm trend vs noise

indicators.threshold_text_en: <50% red / 50-65% yellow / >65% green
indicators.note: McKinsey Q1 2026：72% 企业至少 1 项 AI workload 生产化（2024 为 55%、2020 为 20%），5000+ 人企业达 83%、88% 在至少一个职能用 AI；Deloitte 2026 报告称 ≥40% 项目进入生产的公司数半年内将翻倍。头部部署率高位、深度集成仍在爬坡，维持绿灯（季度调查，沿用 Q1，Q2 调查待发布）
indicators.note_en: McKinsey Q1 2026: 72% of enterprises run at least one AI workload in production (vs 55% in 2024, 20% in 2020), rising to 83% at firms with 5,000+ employees, with 88% using AI in at least one function; Deloitte's 2026 report sees the share of firms with 40%+ of projects in production doubling within six months. The headline rate is high while deep integration keeps climbing — stays green (quarterly survey, Q1 carried, Q2 survey pending)

indicators.threshold_text: 负增长=红 / 减速=黄 / 加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Negative = red / Decel = yellow / Accel = green
indicators.note: Google Cloud 积压本周于 Q2（7/22）升至 $514B（环比 +$50B、云收入 +82% 至 $247.7 亿），叠加 Oracle FY26 Q4 RPO 约 $638B（+363% YoY）、Microsoft 商业 RPO 约 $627B（+99% YoY），大三合计积压 >$1.7T，订单持续强劲；唯 Oracle 逾 50% RPO 来自 OpenAI、客户集中并存，维持绿灯（MSFT/Amazon Q2 RPO 7/29-30 待更新）
indicators.note_en: Google Cloud backlog rose to $514B at Q2 this week (July 22, +$50B sequentially, cloud revenue +82% to $24.77B), which with Oracle's FY26 Q4 RPO of ~$638B (+363% YoY) and Microsoft's ~$627B commercial RPO (+99% YoY) keeps big-3 backlog above $1.7T — a strong order book; but over 50% of Oracle's RPO is from OpenAI, so concentration coexists with strong demand — stays green (MSFT/Amazon Q2 RPO July 29-30 to update)

indicators.threshold_text: 停滞=红 / 放缓=黄 / 正常或加速=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Stalled = red / Decelerating = yellow / On-trend or accelerating = green
indicators.note: 前沿进展仍在轨且偏加速：METR 时程主锚显示最强模型 Claude Mythos 50% 成功率时程已达约 16 小时（超 16 小时因任务库限制测不可靠）、80% 时程约 3 小时，倍增仍约 7 个月轨道；近 90 天旗舰密集发布——Claude Fable 5（Mythos 级、刷新 HLE 无工具 53.3% 与 SWE-bench Pro 80.3% SOTA）、GPT-5.6（含 Sol/Terra，7 月转默认）。capex 第一性支撑（模型持续变好解锁场景）完好，维持绿灯（对比台账上期无实质放缓）
indicators.note_en: Frontier progress stays on-trend and if anything accelerating: METR's primary anchor shows the strongest model, Claude Mythos, at a 50% time horizon of ~16 hours (measurements above 16h are unreliable given the task suite) and an 80% horizon of ~3 hours, with doubling still on a ~7-month track; flagship releases clustered in the last 90 days — Claude Fable 5 (Mythos-class, resetting HLE-no-tools SOTA to 53.3% and SWE-bench Pro to 80.3%) and GPT-5.6 (including Sol/Terra, default in July). The first-principles support for capex (models keep improving, unlocking use cases) is intact — stays green (no material slowdown versus the prior ledger reading)

indicators.threshold_text: 任何=红 / 调查=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Any confirmed = red / Investigation = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 本周无核心 AI 龙头新增正式执法：现有 AI 相关 SEC 案件均较旧且针对非核心/私营标的；Michael Burry 持续指控 hyperscaler 借延长 GPU 折旧于 2026-28 少提约 $176B 折旧、虚增利润（Oracle/Meta 2028 利润或高估约 27%/21%）并点名『循环投资』，但属观点非执法、无 SEC 立案。核心龙头未触及，维持绿灯
indicators.note_en: No new formal enforcement against a core AI bellwether this week: existing AI-related SEC cases are older and against non-core/private names; Michael Burry keeps alleging the hyperscalers understate depreciation by ~$176B over 2026-28 via extended GPU lives to inflate profits (Oracle/Meta profits possibly overstated ~27%/21% by 2028) and flags 'circular investing' — but these are views, not enforcement, with no SEC action. Core leaders remain untouched — stays green

indicators.threshold_text: 加息=红 / 通胀压力=黄 / 降息=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Hike = red / Inflation pressure = yellow / Cut = green
indicators.note: Fed 维持黄灯但内部恶化：CME FedWatch（7/23）显示 7/29 FOMC 约 63.5% 维持、加息概率由上周约 5% 回升至约三分之一（CNBC 7/13 已示『7 月加息概率上升』）。通胀仍粘（higher-for-longer）、中东能源与就业稳健支撑，市场主流仍预期维持而非加息，政策属『维持高利率(通胀压力)』，未改判黄灯——但加息尾部风险重新抬头，是本周黄区内的边际恶化
indicators.note_en: The Fed stays yellow but deteriorates internally: CME FedWatch (July 23) shows ~63.5% hold at the July 29 FOMC, with hike odds rebounding from ~5% last week to roughly one-third (CNBC on July 13 already flagged 'rising July-hike odds'). Inflation is still sticky (higher-for-longer), supported by Middle East energy and solid jobs, but the market still expects a hold rather than a hike, so policy sits at 'higher-for-longer hold (inflation pressure)' and is not re-rated — yet the hike tail-risk has resurfaced, a marginal deterioration within the yellow band this week

indicators.name_zh: 资本开支指引市场反应
indicators.threshold_text: 系统性惩罚=红 / 偶发=黄 / 奖励=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Systematic punishment = red / Episodic = yellow / Rewarded = green
indicators.note: 由黄升红：Alphabet 于 7/22 Q2 云收入 +82%（$247.7 亿）、积压 $514B、EPS 全面超预期，却因把 2026 capex 上调至 $195-205B、预告 2027『显著增加』于 7/23 重挫约 7.4%（Tesla+Alphabet 单日蒸发数千亿，纳指 -2.15%）。连『有云变现→被奖励』阵营标杆都因加码 capex 被重罚，加上上周 TSMC beat-and-sell-off，市场反应函数已切换为无差别惩罚资本开支、要 $700B+ 支出的『回报证据』，判为系统性惩罚红灯（Q2 财报季刚开场，MSFT/Meta 7/29、Amazon 7/30 待交叉确认）
indicators.note_en: Yellow to red: Alphabet's July 22 Q2 beat across the board (cloud +82% to $24.77B, backlog $514B, EPS), yet the stock fell ~7.4% on July 23 for raising 2026 capex to $195-205B and flagging a 'significant increase' in 2027 (Tesla and Alphabet erased hundreds of billions in a session; Nasdaq -2.15%). If even the 'monetizes via cloud → rewarded' bellwether is punished for leaning into capex, and after last week's TSMC beat-and-sell-off, the market's reaction function has switched to punishing capital spending indiscriminately and demanding 'receipts' on the $700B+ spend — a systematic-punishment red (Q2 season just started; MSFT/Meta July 29, Amazon July 30 to cross-confirm)

indicators.threshold_text: 普遍承认过热=红 / 部分=黄 / 无=绿
indicators.threshold_text_en: Widespread acknowledgment = red / Partial = yellow / None = green
indicators.note: 对冲表态持续加深但未成一致：Sundar Pichai 于 Q2 电话会（7/22）警示『AI 泡沫破裂无公司能免，包括我们』；此前 Nadella 称『若只谈科技公司本身就是泡沫的迹象』、Zuckerberg 承认 AI agent 未按预期加速、Altman 称小盘估值『insane』、Dimon 称『bubble territory』。但各家均坚持长期兑现、并集体上调 capex（Alphabet 升至 $195-205B），CEO 未集体收手，维持黄灯
indicators.note_en: Hedging is deepening but not universal: Sundar Pichai on the Q2 call (July 22) warned 'no company will be immune if the AI bubble bursts, including us'; earlier, Nadella said 'talking only about the tech firms is a tell-tale sign of a bubble', Zuckerberg conceded AI agents have not accelerated as expected, Altman called small-cap valuations 'insane', and Dimon said the market is in 'bubble territory'. Yet all insist AI pays off long term and are collectively raising capex (Alphabet to $195-205B), so CEOs have not pulled back — stays yellow
